ja: 正規宝くじは前払い不要
en: Verify at official sites like PCH

references.label: FTC: Fake Prize, Sweepstakes, and Lottery Scams
references.quote: If you have to pay to get your prize, it's a scam. Real prizes are free. So if someone tells you to pay a fee for "taxes," "shipping and handling charges," "processing fees," or "customs duties" to get your prize, you're dealing with a scammer.

verification.note: 'pay to get your prize' is the demand; the notification of prize is the pretext
